checks.name: welcome
checks.text:
◉ Radar by Thally

Hi Alex,

Let’s get to know your business.

Start with your website. Radar reads it to learn what you sell, who buys it and how you sound.

Read your Business Profile and fix anything Radar has missed. Your articles, posts and replies will start from here.
Connect Google Search Console if you have it. You can come back to this later.
Finish setup, then open your dashboard to choose your first article or conversation to work on.

Open Radar

Reply to this email or write to support@thally.io.

Radar is a Thally product, operated by Fairspleet LLC.

checks.name: founder_note
checks.text:
◉ Radar by Thally

Hi Alex,

How’s setup going?

I’m Ekene, Radar’s founder.

The Business Profile is the bit worth spending a few minutes on. It tells Radar who you sell to and how you sound. If that’s wrong, the drafts will be too.

If you’re stuck on a step, reply and tell me where. Or send a line Radar wrote that doesn’t sound like your business.

Thanks for trying Radar.
Ekene

Back to Radar

Reply to this email or write to team@thally.io.

Radar is a Thally product, operated by Fairspleet LLC.

Stop optional setup emails

checks.name: password_reset
checks.text:
◉ Radar by Thally

Hi Alex,

Choose a new password

Use the button below to choose a new password for Radar.

This link works once and expires one hour after you requested it. You’ll need to sign in again on your devices after changing your password.

If you didn’t ask for this, ignore this email. Your password hasn’t changed.

Reset password

Reply to this email or write to support@thally.io.

Radar is a Thally product, operated by Fairspleet LLC.

checks.name: workspace_ready
checks.text:
◉ Radar by Thally

Hi Alex,

Your Business Profile is saved.

Radar will use the profile for Fieldnote to plan topics and draft in your voice.

Open your dashboard and choose what to work on first: an article, a social post or a Daily Brief.

Search Console data and keyword estimates may still be collecting. You’ll see their progress in Radar.

Go to my dashboard

Reply to this email or write to support@thally.io.

Radar is a Thally product, operated by Fairspleet LLC.

checks.name: trial_started
checks.text:
◉ Radar by Thally

Hi Alex,

3 days to try Radar

Your trial ends on November 7, 2026 at 12:00 PM UTC.

The $1.00 you paid to confirm your card comes off your first month. That’s normally $49.00, then $50.00/month. Any tax or other adjustments will be shown on your invoice.

If you don’t want to continue, cancel in Settings → Billing before the trial ends. Otherwise, your subscription will renew automatically.

Manage subscription

Reply to this email or write to support@thally.io.

Radar is a Thally product, operated by Fairspleet LLC.

checks.text:

Hi Alex,

Your trial ends on November 7, 2026 at 12:00 PM UTC.

If you continue, your first month is normally $49.00 after the $1.00 card-confirmation credit, then $50.00/month. Any tax or other adjustments will be shown on your invoice.

No action is needed to keep Radar. To avoid the monthly charge, cancel in Settings → Billing before your trial ends.
